model_output.verdict: Your Army logistics and maintenance leadership comes with team and equipment figures and results that back it up. I’d want to talk with you about an operations supervisor role.
write_up: This is a strong transition resume! Your Army work shows both the people you led and the equipment and logistics you were responsible for. That gives a civilian recruiter a real reason to consider you for an operations supervisor role.

The vehicle readiness line is the model: it gives the starting rate, the new rate, and the ordering and scheduling changes you made. Your progression from mechanic to Platoon Sergeant is easy to follow, and your supply chain degree is clearly marked as in progress.

I don’t think your resume is the thing holding you back. Bring the vehicle readiness result higher in the latest role, and add what you taught the junior mechanics. How competitive a particular civilian job is will still matter.

cards.line: - Accountable for $14M of vehicles, tools, and equipment with zero losses on three annual inventories
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model too. It names what you were accountable for and shows the inventory record alongside it.
A recruiter can see how many mechanics you trained, but not what you taught them. That detail would show what you passed on from your own work.
cards.question: What skills did you train the junior mechanics in?

cards.line: - Led, trained, and evaluated 38 soldiers across maintenance, supply, and fuel sections
cards.cannot_tell: For a role above supervisor, a recruiter will look for how you set direction across those sections and what decisions were yours.
cards.example: Led, trained, and evaluated 38 soldiers across maintenance, supply, and fuel sections, setting [direction] and making [decision]
cards.question: What direction did you set across the sections, and what decisions did you make?

cards.line: - Cut the unit's vehicle non-mission-capable rate from 18% to 6% in a year by changing the parts ordering process and the weekly maintenance schedule
cards.cannot_tell: This is your strongest result, and it sits below three other lines. Move it to the top of the Platoon Sergeant role so the change you made is seen first.

fit.why: Your resume names an operations supervisor role as your goal and shows you leading maintenance, supply, and fuel sections.
fit.level: manager, led 38 soldiers and had 6 direct-report sergeants
fit.note: Your maintenance and inventory work also points toward supply chain supervision. For civilian applications, explain Army terms where needed without changing the work you did.
